meta.title: Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: Accessing or submitting invoices through the Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal
Verifying that the capability is absent or refused specifically because the tenant is on the Growth plan
Repeating the same invoice submission workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verifying that it works
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Accessing or submitting invoices through the Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal; Verifying that the capability is absent or refused specifically because the tenant is on the Growth plan; Repeating the same invoice submission workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verifying that it works

args.need: sign in as the vendor on the Growth-plan tenant and the Enterprise-plan tenant, open the Vendor Self-Service Invoice Submission Portal, submit the same invoice workflow on both, and report that Growth is unavailable or refused while Enterprise succeeds

steps.note: The catalog cannot reach or observe the invoice submission portal or compare plan entitlements.
After the tester's interaction, verify the available vendor authentication screen using the only known vendor-portal label; this does not assert invoice capability.
